description: For our next phase of single-family homes we want to drop the OSB on exterior walls and put 50 mm rigid foam directly on the studs, then large-format fibre cement panels screwed through the foam into the studs. The panels need fastening between studs according to the maker. Racking would be handled by let-in steel strap bracing.
known_facts: fibre cement panels needing intermediate fastening
